experimental_design: Only a single P. falciparum strain (3D7) is analyzed with no comparison group described; no experimental variable is manipulated between groups.
factor_value: No experimental variable is manipulated between groups; this is a single-condition phosphoproteomics study.
number_of_fractions: No offline peptide fractionation (SCX, high-pH RP, gel bands) is described; IMAC is an enrichment step, not a fractionation scheme.
number_of_technical_replicates: 'Phosphopeptides from two IMAC purifications were pooled and split into 6 aliquots for LC-MS/MS analysis.'
number_of_biological_replicates: Only one P. falciparum 3D7 culture preparation is described with no mention of independent biological replicates.
number_of_samples: A single pooled protein sample (4 mg) from one P. falciparum 3D7 culture is described; all LC-MS/MS injections derive from this single biological preparation.
